_about: When the game offers the next thing: every number that says when a call may ring or an offer may come, in seconds of play unless it says hours. [a, b] seconds means a random time between a and b; hours [from, to] may run past midnight (17 to 2). Each source keeps its own countdown and reads its numbers here (pacer.gd). How long a card stays up, distances, and the offers that come from driving past a place (deliveries, the round-up, rivals' challenges, friends met in person) have no clock and are not here. check_pacing.gd checks this file.

calls._note: Every friend's call: at least gap s after the last call of anyone, and settle s into a calm spell (after a result, a chase or a quest). A call the player asked for does not wait.

rescue._note: The rescue line (WEZWANIE): the first call this long after the start, the next this long after a rescue ends or is skipped.

activity._note: The default for an activity of the kit that sets nothing of its own: the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

boat._note: Szymek's boat race: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

kino._note: The cinema tour: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

dekalog._note: The Dekalog tour: between these hours, the first call after first_call s, then every call_cool s.

shisha._note: Ivan's shisha night: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a night or a no; a call that could not ring tries again after retry s.

crawl._note: The bar crawl: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a crawl or a no; retry as above.

meet._note: Darek's night racing club: between these hours; the first call, then the next after a night or a no; retry as above.

rave._note: Mati's nights: his tease between tease_hours, the first after first_tease s and the next after next_tease s; his call call_after s after the tease; retry as above.

ev_tow._note: Bartek's EV tow: the first call, then the next after a tow or a no; retry as above. The stranded cars: the first after first_strand s, the next strand_gap s after one clears.

rides._note: Podwózka: the first request after first_offer s of driving, then offer_gap s after each ride or request; a request held by the first minutes' guide comes at least hold_gap s after the hold lets go.

trend._note: The trend courier's orders. Dżemini: first after dz_first s, again dz_cool s after a skip. Kawa: between kawa_hours, first after kawa_first s, then every kawa_cool s. Deski (padel): between deski_hours, first after deski_first s, then every deski_cool s. A slot offers again after slot_cool s; Mlask between ml_hours, again after ml_cool s. card_rest s after a card closes before the next offer; call_rest s after a rescue ends before a friend's call.
